text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘India on the Moon’ (चाँद पर भारत)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘India on the Moon’ (Chaand par Bharat). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘India on the Moon’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘spacecraft’ मतलब अंतरिक्ष यान। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘spacecraft’ matlab antariksh yaan. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘spacecraft’ means अंतरिक्ष यान. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘moon’ मतलब चाँद। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘moon’ matlab chaand. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘moon’ means चाँद. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘scientists’ मतलब वैज्ञानिक। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘scientists’ matlab vaigyanik. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘scientists’ means वैज्ञानिक. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: A few years ago, India sent a spacecraft to the moon.
It landed near the south pole of the moon.
India was the first country to land there.
A small rover came out of the lander.
It moved on the moon and sent pictures back to Earth.
Scientists at ISRO worked for many years for this day.

question.hi: अंतरिक्ष यान का नाम क्या था?
question.hinglish: Antariksh yaan ka naam kya tha?

question.hi: रोवर ने धरती पर क्या भेजा?
question.hinglish: Rover ne dharti par kya bheja?
question.en: What did the rover send to Earth?
